resampling: calendar-day distance; ISO calendar week = block for the autocorrelation interval; moving blocks on the calendar-day axis; seed 42, 4000 draws

pooled.label: original statistic (Rev 1), reported beside the Rev 3 rule statistic rho_1

residualAutocorr.statement: serial dependence at the day scale is not supported by these data at this precision (not evidence of absence)
residualAutocorr.powerDisclosure: harness on this day grid (simulated outcomes, 1000 replications): the rho_1 rule has power 67 % at phi = 0.3 and 99.6 % at phi = 0.6 and a false-support rate of 1.9 % under the null; the pre-registered criterion of at most 10 % misclassification fails at phi = 0.3 (33 % not supported); moderate dependence (phi about 0.3) is not excluded
residualAutocorr.forkingPathNote: the rule statistic was switched from rho_{1-3} to rho_1 after simulation power was seen and before any real outcome was computed; the lag-1 value of about 0.25 from the self-audit was known; the original statistic is reported beside
residualAutocorr.multiplicityNote: rho_2 and rho_3 are descriptive and were not pre-specified as rules; the rule uses rho_1 only and no multiplicity adjustment is made across lags
residualAutocorr.bootstrapNote: the percentile interval of rho_1 is shifted: the bootstrap median lies below the point estimate (bootstrapMedian vs rho); no bias correction is applied
residualAutocorr.pairsAssignedTo: ISO week of the first day; week pair-sets resampled, design refitted by weighted least squares in every draw

vifDiagnostic.note: diagnostic ratio relative to independent days; no interval; phi is taken from the attenuated rho_1 (hat-matrix), so the ratio is likely understated

gls.note: separate estimator on day means (not the released slope); outside every rule; never described as a correction

misspecControl.reading: the control does not separate slow-varying mean structure from short-memory dependence at this precision

misspecControl.descriptiveNote: reported descriptively whatever the rule result (Rev 3 item 3; Rev 1 had conditioned the control on a supported result)
misspecControl.spline: y ~ T + I + cubic truncated-power spline of calendar day (4 interior knots at day quantiles, linear term included; months column removed)

harnessCoverage.note: rates carry Monte Carlo errors (mcse); differences within about 2 mcse are not 'better'; CR1 under-covers under dependence and HAC L=14 under-covers under the null; the new rows are partial remedies, never 'corrected'; a drop from rho_pre to rho_post also occurs under pure AR(1) and is not read as seasonal

reportingRule: the new rows follow the M406 rows in this fixed order with the same format; no single interval is designated primary and no envelope is formed; the L=7 label is weekly-scale truncation, not preferred; GLS is a different estimator outside every rule
reading: sensitivities of conditional intervals to serial dependence between neighbouring days; they do not remove season, logging-regime or calendar-drift confounding and do not change the released estimators; 'not supported' is not evidence of absence
limits: most day pairs at distance 1-3 days come from dense weeks; larger distances are imprecise
a smooth drift and positive residual autocorrelation are not separable without a model of the mean; the control addresses one direction only
HAC and block procedures are asymptotic with about 22 effective weeks; GLS assumes a stationary Gaussian AR(1)
none of these procedures removes confounding by season, logging regime or calendar

season (or any smooth drift) collinear with months enters the slope and is invisible to residual diagnostics (a seasonal signal absorbed by the months regressor produced no residual autocorrelation in the harness)
